title: Per-REST-cell contract/integration test register
decision: D14 — broad reading: every M0.2 REST cell; the AgentController cells are an explicit M3.1 dependency

evidenceKinds.derivation: the test file binds the implementing controller (new X(...), Nest get(X)/resolve(X), or a : X annotation) and calls the manifest's handler method on something
evidenceKinds.limit: it does not prove the call asserted anything, and a file binding two controllers that share a handler name joins both

evidenceKinds.derivation: the test file issues a request whose method and normalised path land on the cell's route template; literal template segments must match exactly and a path matching more than one cell joins none
evidenceKinds.limit: a URL composed at run time from values this parser cannot see is invisible, so a tested cell can read as residue; that is the safe direction

statedLimit: an evidence row proves a test file EXECUTES the cell, not that it asserts anything about it; the register is a lower bound on execution and therefore an upper bound on nothing — residue is the set of cells no tracked test file touches at all

m31Dependency.countedAs: neither covered nor residue; the third number is published so the carve-out cannot read as progress
